title: Feature flag registry
description: Every rollout switch in ComplianceWatch: its owner, its default, when it expires and what removes it. make flags-check validates packages/flags/registry.json against this schema.

flags.description: One entry per flag, sorted by name.

name.description: Dotted, lower case: <area>.<switch>. CW_FLAG_<NAME> (dots become underscores) overrides it in the env provider.

default.description: A bool flag defaults to false; a string flag defaults to its off value, one of values.

values.description: Every value a string flag takes; the default is one of them.

removal.description: The condition under which the flag is deleted from the code and from this registry.

expires.description: The date by which the flag is removed or its owner extends it with a reason.

targeting.description: tenant: the flag can be on for some tenants only (the tenant id is the targeting key).

env.description: The environment variable the code already reads for this switch, when it has one.

tenants_env.description: The environment variable holding the tenant allow-list (comma-separated tenant ids), when the code already reads one.

services.description: The services, apps and packages that read the flag (directory names).
